high_confidence_subset.rationale: Specialist construction SME advisory with explicit systemization focus, named leadership, live contact, fixed-scope methodology
Dedicated construction coaching, named primary coach (Reuben), construction case studies, clear methodology
Australia's largest builders coach, named founder (Mick Hawes, 35+ years), Perth location, specific construction business methodology
Construction/trade specialist, 500+ clients, clear scaling methodology, live contact info
Named leadership (Brett Rice, David Ridgway), construction services focus, Perth-based, strategic planning methodology
Named coach (Stephen Kay, 18+ years), explicit construction industry focus, systems/team building services

identified_gaps: Limited number of dedicated construction succession planning specialists - most succession services come from generalist accountants/lawyers rather than construction-focused advisors
Few firms with explicit construction owner exit strategy positioning - opportunity for specialized advisor focused on construction business acquisitions/mergers
Limited 'delegation coach' specialists for construction - most coaches focus on general business systems rather than owner disengagement frameworks
Lack of construction-specific leadership team development coaches - most are generalist leadership coaches
what_would_unlock_more_discoveries: Direct outreach to construction industry associations (MBA-WA, HIA, RIEWA) for advisor referrals
LinkedIn searches for 'construction business advisor' and 'construction operations manager' titles in Perth
Industry publication searches (Construction News, Property Council journals) for featured advisors
Construction company websites - mining 'advisor' and 'consultant' testimonials to identify boutique advisory relationships
Growth consultancy directories and certification bodies (Scaling Up, EOS implementers, Verne Harnish affiliates) filtered by Perth + construction

methodology_notes.search_strategy: 5-angle parallel web searches with 2-3 variations per angle, covering (1) construction coaches, (2) SME scaling, (3) succession planning, (4) systems/delegation, (5) independent advisors
methodology_notes.verification_approach: Live website URL testing + leadership/positioning extraction via WebFetch tool
methodology_notes.confidence_scoring: Based on verified live website + named leadership presence + clear construction/SME advisory positioning + contact information accuracy
exclusion_criteria_applied: National franchises without Perth-specific presence or named local leadership
Pure project management firms without business advisory positioning
Engineering consultancies (ACOR, BWCE) - excluded as technical/engineering focus, not business advisory
Equipment rental/labour hire operations - excluded as vendor-focused not advisory
Accounting firms without explicit construction advisory positioning

strong_fit_criteria: Named leadership accessible for decision-maker enrichment
Explicit construction or SME advisory positioning
Business operations/systems focus vs. technical project management
Live website with clear service descriptions
